evidence.description: Round-3's specific casing fix (`freshBorrower.agent_id ?? freshBorrower.agentId`) is itself a correct, minimal, well-targeted read IF the registry ever carried `agent_id` on a real row. It does not, in this codebase, ever carry that field -- see FIND-201. So the fix does not close G3's actual functional gap; it only changes which field name is (still, always) undefined.

The ACTUAL citizens-registry append (`citizenRecord`, then `appendCitizenRecord(citizensRegistryFile, citizenRecord)`) omits agent_id/agent_evm_address entirely -- independently confirmed against this repo's own spawn-orchestrator.test.mjs:494-510 exhaustive schema assertion (no agent_id) and citizens.seed.json's own Franklin row (no agent_id). See FIND-201 for the full chain.

G3's own done-criterion ('閾値設定時に実績不足 borrower が弾かれる' -- a configured gate must reject the INSUFFICIENT, i.e. implicitly PASS the sufficient) is still not achievable in production: a configured gate rejects ALL borrowers unconditionally via the 'no_borrower_agent_id' fail-closed branch, because borrowerAgentId is genuinely always undefined for every real citizen row, spawned or genesis.

The 3 new round-3 tests genuinely exercise the REAL isBorrowerEligibleWithReputationGate -> passesOnchainReputationGate chain (deps.reputationGateFn is NOT overridden, confirmed by direct read) and their own internal logic (sufficient-PASS/insufficient-REJECT/missing-agentId-fail-closed) is correct GIVEN their fixture. But the fixture (`baseCitizen(BORROWER, { agent_id: '42' })`) is hand-invented by this feature's own test file and has now been proven, by a DIFFERENT part of this same repo (spawn-orchestrator.test.mjs:494-510, citizens.seed.json), to never match a real citizens-registry row's shape. No test anywhere in this feature's 51 new tests (48 round-1/2 + 3 round-3) exercises the gate against a citizen record shaped exactly like `spawn-orchestrator.mjs`'s own real `citizenRecord` object (id/wallet/walletAddress/fuel/humanDependencies/homeDir/coLocatedWithCoordinator, no agent_id) or `citizens.seed.json`'s real seeded row -- both of which WOULD reproduce the exact false-rejection FIND-101 originally reported and these 3 tests claim to have fixed.

Reads a field (agent_id, and its camelCase fallback) that this repo's own real citizens-registry write path never populates -- confirmed by tracing every file under skills/ that writes to CITIZENS_REGISTRY_PATH (spawn-orchestrator.mjs's appendCitizenRecord call site, the only runtime writer) and the git-tracked seed (citizens.seed.json, the only bootstrap writer). Neither ever sets agent_id/agent_evm_address on a citizens-registry row.

Round-3's own diff (the field-read line, its comment, and the 3 new tests) is minimal, single-call-site, and matches this file's own established DI-parameter/fail-open/fail-closed/comment-density conventions -- no duplication, no dead code introduced by this round's own change. (FIND-201 is a data-plumbing/spec-fidelity defect in a DIFFERENT, pre-existing file -- spawn-orchestrator.mjs's citizen-registry-vs-ledger split predates this feature and is not itself disorganized code introduced by this round.)

The same class of gap round-2's own verdict flagged for PROP-048 (a mock-based proof accepted as sufficient for an integration-level claim) recurs here one layer deeper: no PROP-ID in this feature's verification architecture requires 'the reputation-gate integration test's borrower fixture matches the ACTUAL schema spawn-orchestrator.mjs's own appendCitizenRecord (or the seed file) produces' -- so a fixture that quietly diverges from the real production data shape (as round-3's own 3 new tests do) passes every existing proof obligation while still leaving G3 functionally inert in production.

Direct read of every file this round's changes touch or that FIND-201's trace passed through: no wallet private key is read/logged outside its documented DI parameter in any of these files; ensure-gas.mjs's decideGasAction never auto-spends on mainnet (isMainnet:true always returns needs_gas, never drip); reputation-gate.mjs's gateConfigured short-circuit means an unconfigured gate (the shipped default) never even reads borrowerAgentId or calls getSummaryFn -- confirmed byte-identical to pre-wiring behavior via lending-orchestrator.test.mjs's own dedicated 'defaults to active' test. FIND-201 causes a gate to over-REFUSE (fail closed), never to authorize an unintended disbursement -- it is a functional/spec defect, not a money-safety-boundary violation.

`git diff main --stat` could not be independently executed (no Bash tool). File-boundary scope was instead verified by direct content review of every file named in state.json's own moneySafetyFileBoundaryCheck claim (lending-orchestrator.mjs + its test file) plus every file this round's own FIND-201 trace required reading (spawn-orchestrator.mjs, child-spec.js, wake-gate.mjs, citizens.seed.json) -- none contain key material, .env access, or spend-cap constants. This is REASONED (direct read), not VERIFIED (executed diff).
Independently counted `test(...)` block occurrences via Grep: 167 across 10 files, exactly matching state.json's claimed lending count.
Independently counted: 82 across 8 files, exactly matching state.json's claimed gig count. 167+82=249 matches the claimed combined total.

`node --test` could not be independently executed (no Bash tool) -- pass/fail execution outcomes and the REQ-116 pre-existing-flake claim are read from the builder's own evidence/sprint-1-*-phase-round3.log, not independently re-run this round. This is the same, explicitly-documented limitation round-2's own review accepted as non-blocking given strong count corroboration and no sign of fabricated transcripts.

passesOnchainReputationGate's branch logic matches behavioral-spec.md REQ-011's Edge Cases exactly, line for line: configured+no borrowerAgentId -> fail-closed (reputation-gate.mjs:32); configured+empty clientAddresses -> fail-open (line 33-35); getSummaryFn {ok:false} -> fail-open (line 38-40); minJobCount/minScore checks independently short-circuit-able (line 42-47). Internally consistent with the spec's own stated ERC-8004 ReputationGateHook port.

Contract addresses/ABI and the header comment's own live-verification claims (getVersion/getIdentityRegistry eth_call results) are UNCHANGED from prior rounds and not touched by round 3's diff; this session had no network tool to re-verify on-chain liveness independently, so that specific sub-claim is REASONED (unchanged code, previously reviewed), not re-VERIFIED this round.

Both the round-3 fix's own inline comment and FIND-101.json's evidence chain assert, with specific line-number citations and high confidence, that 'the real, on-disk citizen-registry row stores the borrower's ERC-8004 identity under snake_case agent_id (canonical write site: skills/self/spawn/lib/child-spec.js:65 ... also spawn-orchestrator.mjs's own agent_id: identityResult.agentId write)'. This claim is FALSE: those two cited lines write the CHILDREN LEDGER (a different file/store), not the citizens-registry row the gate actually reads at runtime -- the real citizens-registry write, 30-60 lines further down in the SAME function (spawn-orchestrator.mjs:713-724), was not checked before this claim was asserted as fact, despite this round's entire task being specifically about registry-row shape. The cited line numbers are real and exist (not hallucinated), but they do not establish what the claim says they establish. This is not a fabricated test result -- the 3 new tests genuinely pass against their own fixture, and the test counts are genuinely accurate -- but it is a confident, specific, checkable factual claim about this codebase's own data model that was never actually checked against the sibling code three lines away, and it was allowed to become the load-bearing justification for closing round 2's critical finding.

convergenceSignals.priorRoundFindingsResolutionNote: FIND-001/003/004/005 (round 2) independently re-confirmed still resolved, unregressed by round 3, via full-file re-reads of ensure-gas.mjs (lines 194-231) and lending-gate-reputation-composition.test.mjs (all 5 tests). FIND-101's OWN specific complaint (wrong field casing, freshBorrower.agentId vs .agent_id) is genuinely fixed -- lending-orchestrator.mjs:395 now reads the correct casing. But independent re-tracing of the full data-flow chain this round (reputation-gate.mjs -> lending-orchestrator.mjs -> wake-gate.mjs's buildDefaultGetCitizen -> CITIZENS_REGISTRY_PATH -> every real writer of that file) surfaced that NEITHER casing of the field is EVER present on a real citizens-registry row -- the citation FIND-101's own fix used to justify 'this is the canonical write site' actually pointed at a different store (the children ledger). The net, user-visible defect FIND-101 originally reported (a configured reputation gate rejects 100% of real borrowers, defeating G3's entire purpose) is UNCHANGED and still present after round 3's fix, now tracked as FIND-201 because its confirmed root cause differs from what FIND-101/the round-3 fix addressed.
